newsitem.title: USA: Sonoco to expand Indiana plastic bag plant.
newsitem.headline: Sonoco to expand Indiana plastic bag plant.

text.p: Sonoco Products Inc said on Friday that it was expanding its plastic bag manufacturing capacity at an Indiana plant by over two billion bags, as part of its planned expansion.

The expansion of the North Vernon plant would cost between $25 million to $30 million and would include a building addition, several new bag machines and upgrades to the processes at the plant, the company said.

Sonoco said it received training incentives from the state and some tax relief from the local governments to help with this capacity expansion. The plant's capacity was also expanded by two billion bags in 1995.
